name: cx-box-carry
task: Carry the box to the exit, and whenever the box falls, pick it up again.

value.feedback: CHANGES REQUIRED: The task requires the agent to reach the exit, i.e., an event that is not currently represented by a hard goal clause. Add a hard Existence(at_exit) clause. This will provide a final state and correct the rule‑only warning, while the existing Response clauses correctly enforce holding the box at exit and after any box fall.

CHANGES REQUIRED: The task requires that the agent reach the exit while still holding the box. The clause list contains a hard Response(at_exit, holding_box), which enforces that after reaching the exit the agent must hold the box, the opposite of the requirement. This clause is not present in the task wording and misstates the goal. Replace or remove the Response(at_exit, holding_box) clause, and add a hard Existence(holding_box) that is required at the time of exit, or equivalently a hard Existence(at_exit) together with a hard Existence(holding_box) that holds simultaneously. This will correctly capture “carry the box to the exit”. The clause about picking up the box after a fall is correct.}

texts: The agent must reach the exit
Whenever the agent reaches the exit, it must be holding the box
Whenever the box falls, the agent must pick it up again
